# AnyDag local server

<!-- Generated by `npm run openapi` from the code; `npm run checks` fails when it is stale. Do not edit. -->

Version 1 · OpenAPI 3.1.0 · the document: [`local.openapi.json`](local.openapi.json)

The server the AnyDag app runs on this machine (`anydag serve`, the desktop app, `npm run dev`): one vault or several, every file in them, and everything the page, the CLI and the MCP server do to them. It listens on `127.0.0.1` only.

**Every request carries the launch's token**, as the `X-AnyDag-Token` header (what `anydag` prints, and the desktop app hands its page) or the cookie a browser is given under `/s/<secret>/`, and a `Host` that is this machine (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost` or `[::1]`; anything else is a `421`). A write whose only credential is the cookie must come from the page's own origin.

**A route about one vault** takes `?vault=<id>`; with none, the vault opened first. `GET /api/vaults` lists them.

**Every write to a text carries the sha1 it was read at** as `base`. A stale one is a `409` with the text that replaced it and its own `base`, `{error, base, text}`: merge and send again. Every other refusal is `{error, code?}` — branch on `code` where there is one, never on `error`, which is a sentence for a person.

Generated from the code (`server/openapi.ts`, `server/schema/`): do not edit it by hand.

### `GET /api/health`

**What is answering.**

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `health`.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`Health`](#schema-health) | Its version, vault and switches. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |

**Open a folder as a vault.** Opening never writes a byte of it. A vault inside another, or around one, is refused.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `openVault`.

Body (`application/json`): [`OpenVaultBody`](#schema-openvaultbody).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | { vault: [`Vault`](#schema-vault) } | The vault. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No path, or a folder that cannot be a vault. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |

**Move a document or a folder to another open vault.** Copy, then delete: a failure leaves two copies, never none. A name taken there is numbered; a folder taken there is a 409.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `transfer`.

| Status | Body | Description |

| 200 | { name: string; kind: [`Kind`](#schema-kind); id: string, or `null`; to: string } or { folder: string; boards: list of string; notes: list of string; quizzes: list of string; tables: list of string; files: list of string; folders: list of string; to: string } | Where it landed: a document's name, kind and id, or a folder's every folder and document. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault to move to, the vault it is in already, a `kind` that is not one, or no folder. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No such document or folder, or a vault that is not open. No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |

## files

<a id="op-upload"></a>

### `POST /__board/file`

**Upload a file.** The bytes are the body, streamed into the vault and never held whole: checked against the limit and hashed as they pass. One that stops half-way, or that is not the `Content-Length` it said, leaves nothing behind.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `upload`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | query | string | yes | What it was called: its extension says what it is. |
| `folder` | query | string | no | The folder to keep it in; left out, the top. |
| `title` | query | string | no | Its title; left out, its name. |

Body (`application/octet-stream`): bytes.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | { name: string; id: string, or `null`; title: string, or `null`; ext: string; mime: string; bytes: integer; sha256: string } | The attachment as kept, and the sha256 of what arrived. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A folder that is not one, a file under `components/`, a name the vault refuses, or bytes that did not arrive whole. |

| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 413 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | Over the upload limit. |
| 415 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No extension, one this vault does not take, or a name a file cannot have. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |

| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |

**Pair the vault with a sync server.** With a one-time code its admin made. Pairing links nothing yet: `/api/sync/link` does.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `syncPair`.

| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | An address that is not a sync server's, or no code; or The sync server's refusal, its `ES_*` in `code`. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |

<a id="op-synclink"></a>

### `POST /api/sync/link`

**Link the vault to a remote.** `upload` answers the recovery code, once; `download` re-keys the vault, so the page reloads onto `?vault=<vault>`.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `syncLink`.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | { status: [`SyncStatus`](#schema-syncstatus); recovery: string; vault: string } | The status, the recovery code (`upload` only), and the vault's id now. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A `mode` that is not one, a passphrase too short or that does not open the key, a recovery code mistyped or not this vault's, no remote named; or the sync server's refusal. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The account has no such remote: `ES_NOT_FOUND`. No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The vault is linked or not paired, the remote has no key or is linked on this machine, a `download` into a vault that holds documents, or this process could not keep the key (`secret`). A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The link was kept but its sync did not start. Otherwise, a defect: Hono's plain text, the error logged here and never sent. |
| 502 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The sync server did not answer: `ES_NETWORK`. |

### `POST /api/sync/now`

**Sync now.**

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `syncNow`.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`SyncStatus`](#schema-syncstatus) | The status once a pull and a push finished. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The vault is not linked: `{code: "unlinked"}`. A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |

<a id="op-syncdevices"></a>

### `GET /api/sync/devices`

**The account's devices.**

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `syncDevices`.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`SyncDevices`](#schema-syncdevices) | Every device, revoked ones too. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The server no longer accepts this device: `ES_AUTH`; or The sync server's refusal, its `ES_*` in `code`. A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The vault is not paired: `{code: "unpaired"}`. A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |
| 502 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The sync server did not answer: `ES_NETWORK`. |

<a id="op-syncrevoke"></a>

### `POST /api/sync/devices/revoke`

**Sign a device out of the account.**

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `syncRevoke`.

Body (`application/json`): [`RevokeBody`](#schema-revokebody).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`SyncDevices`](#schema-syncdevices) | The devices now. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No `id`. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The server no longer accepts this device: `ES_AUTH`; or The sync server's refusal, its `ES_*` in `code`. A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No such device: `ES_NOT_FOUND`. No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The vault is not paired: `{code: "unpaired"}`. A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |
| 502 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The sync server did not answer: `ES_NETWORK`. |

## feedback

Send feedback. Only when the build's `cloud` switch is on.

<a id="op-feedbackinfo"></a>

### `GET /api/feedback`

**Where feedback goes.**

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `feedbackInfo`.

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | { destination: string, or `null`; env: { version: string; os: string; arch: string } } | The relay's host, `null` when this app has none, and the version, system and architecture a send carries. |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |

<a id="op-feedback"></a>

### `POST /api/feedback`

**Send a bug or an idea.** Forwarded to the relay that makes it a GitHub issue. A chat may not call it.

Token: `token` (This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs), or `cookie` (The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path). Operation id: `feedback`.

Body (`application/json`): [`FeedbackBody`](#schema-feedbackbody).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | { url: string } | The issue. |
| 400 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A `kind`, `text`, list of names or file that is not one, or what the relay refused (`feedback-invalid`). |
| 401 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The request did not carry this launch's token (`X-AnyDag-Token`, or the cookie under `/s/<secret>/`): `{code: "token"}`. |
| 403 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A chat's tools asked for something the chat may not reach: `chat-refused`, `not-granted`, `read-only`, or `declined` when the person said no. A write whose only credential is the cookie came from another origin: `origin`. |
| 404 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A document named that is not in the vault. No vault is open, or `?vault=` names one that is not: `{code: "vault"}`. |
| 409 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | A request carrying `X-AnyDag-Chat` for a chat with no turn running: `{code: "no-turn"}`. |
| 500 | `text/plain` | A defect in the server: its error is logged here, never sent. |
| 502 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | The relay could not be reached (`feedback-unreachable`), or answered what it should not. |
| 503 | [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal) | This app has no feedback relay: `ES_UNAVAILABLE`. |

## Schemas

<a id="schema-health"></a>

### `Health`

What is answering: its version, the vault it serves, and what this build carries.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | `true` | yes |  |
| `service` | `"anydag"` | yes |  |
| `version` | string | yes |  |
| `store` | `"vault"` | yes |  |
| `vault` | string, or `null` | yes | The open vault's folder, `null` when none is open. |
| `mcp` | string | yes |  |
| `app` | string | yes |  |
| `features` | { cloud } | yes | The build's switches (`server/features.ts`): `cloud` carries sync, logs and feedback. |
| `features.cloud` | boolean | yes |  |

<a id="schema-refusal"></a>

### `Refusal`

Every refusal: `error` is a sentence for a person. `code`, where there is one, is what a client branches on; `reason` says why a model could not be reached.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | yes |  |
| `code` | string | no |  |
| `reason` | { code, provider } | no | Why a model provider could not be used: `code` is the provider's state (`not-installed`, `needs-key`, `busy`, `timeout`, …). |
| `reason.code` | string | yes |  |
| `reason.provider` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-me"></a>

The one local user — there is no sign-in — and the time zone times are read and written in, `null` for this machine's.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | { uid, handle, email, name } | yes |  |
| `account.uid` | `"local"` | yes |  |
| `account.handle` | `"local"` | yes |  |
| `account.email` | `""` | yes |  |
| `account.name` | string | yes |  |
| `zone` | string, or `null` | yes |  |

The vault as a graph (`src/graph/wire.ts`): documents as parallel arrays, links as pairs of indexes into them, and the fields a view colours, filters and groups by.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | `1` | yes | The wire's version. |
| `ids` | list of string | yes |  |
| `names` | list of string | yes |  |
| `titles` | list of string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `links` | list of integer | yes | Pairs of document indexes, flat: `[from, to, from, to, …]`. |
| `fields` | list of { key, label, none, type, tree, values, of, start, items } | yes |  |
| `fields[].key` | string | yes |  |
| `fields[].label` | string | yes |  |
| `fields[].none` | string | yes |  |
| `fields[].type` | `"one"` or `"many"` | yes |  |
| `fields[].tree` | `true` | no |  |
| `fields[].values` | list of { key, label } | yes |  |
| `fields[].values[].key` | string | yes |  |
| `fields[].values[].label` | string | yes |  |
| `fields[].of` | list of integer | no |  |
| `fields[].start` | list of integer | no |  |
| `fields[].items` | list of integer | no |  |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `title` | string, or `null` | yes |  |

| `refs[].type` | string | yes |  |
| `refs[].part` | string | no | A block anchor or an item id inside the target. |
| `refs[].text` | string | yes |  |
| `refs[].target` | { id, name, kind, title }, or `null` | yes |  |
| `backlinks` | list of { id, name, kind, title, type } | yes |  |
| `backlinks[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `backlinks[].name` | string | yes |  |

| `backlinks[].type` | string | yes |  |

| `docs[].units[].text` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-patchbody"></a>

### `PatchBody`

Edits to a board's items, applied to the text the board has now.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ops` | list of {  } | no | The edits, each an object: `ops: [{ id, attrs?, body?, type? } \| { id, remove: true } \| { id, move } \| { insert: "<fenced item text>" \| { type, attrs, body }, after? } \| { meta }]`. Left out, none. |
| `base` | string, or `null` | no | The sha1 the text was read at (`base` of the read). Left out or `null`, the write is made over whatever is there; any other string that is not the file's sha1 now — `""` included — is a 409 with the text that won. |

<a id="schema-version"></a>

### `Version`

The text as it is now, and its sha1 to send as the next write's `base`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | string | yes | The sha1 of the text, which a write sends back as `base`. |
| `text` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-conflictorrefusal"></a>

### `ConflictOrRefusal`

The text that won (`Conflict`), or a refusal with no text: the file kept changing, or a chat has no turn running.

One of:

- [`Conflict`](#schema-conflict)

- [`Refusal`](#schema-refusal)

<a id="schema-conflict"></a>

### `Conflict`

A write whose `base` is not the file's sha1 any more: nothing was written. `base` and `text` are the file as it is now — rebase the edit on them and send it again with that `base`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | string | yes |  |
| `base` | string | yes | The sha1 of the text that won. |
| `text` | string | yes | The text that won. |

<a id="schema-putbody"></a>

### `PutBody`

A whole text, written over the document.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The whole text. |
| `base` | string, or `null` | no | The sha1 the text was read at (`base` of the read). Left out or `null`, the write is made over whatever is there; any other string that is not the file's sha1 now — `""` included — is a 409 with the text that won. |

<a id="schema-createbody"></a>

### `CreateBody`

A new document. A text with a `title:` is filed under that title in `name`'s folder (decision 14); a name that is taken is numbered.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The whole text. A board's items and a table's tabs, columns and rows are given ids. |
| `kind` | `"board"` or `"note"` or `"quiz"` or `"table"` | no | Which kind; left out, a board. |
| `name` | string | no | Where to file it; left out, the kind's name. Only a board lives under `components/`. |
| `id` | string | no | The id to give it, when it is free. |

<a id="schema-created"></a>

### `Created`

The document as it was filed: the name it settled on, its id, its text and sha1.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `id` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `base` | string | yes | The sha1 of the text, which a write sends back as `base`. |
| `text` | string | yes |  |

### `RenameBody`

A document and the name it is to have.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The document's name: its path in the vault without the suffix. |
| `kind` | `"board"` or `"note"` or `"quiz"` or `"table"` or `"file"` | no | Which kind; left out, a board. |
| `to` | string | no | The new name; left out or `null`, the same name (a copy is numbered). Only a board lives under `components/`. |

The name the document settled on and its id; a rename also says which links it kept (`relinked`), a copy does not.

| `id` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `relinked` | [`Relinked`](#schema-relinked) | no |  |

### `Relinked`

The `[[wikilinks]]` a change of name kept pointing at the document: how many, in which files, and the files that kept changing and were not rewritten. `null` when the vault does not update links.

|---|---|---|---|
| `links` | integer | yes |  |
| `files` | list of [`Named`](#schema-named) | yes |  |
| `missed` | list of [`Named`](#schema-named) | yes |  |

- any, or `null`

<a id="schema-taskbody"></a>

### `TaskBody`

What to change of a note that is a task. A field left out stays as it is; `null` takes its line out. At least one is sent.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The note's name. |
| `status` | `"todo"` or `"in-progress"` or `"done"`, or `null` | no | The status; `null` makes the note no task. |
| `due` | string, or `null` | no | `due`: `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` to take it out. |
| `start` | string, or `null` | no | `start`: `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` to take it out. |
| `priority` | `"urgent"` or `"high"` or `"medium"` or `"low"`, or `null` | no | The priority, or `null` for none. |

<a id="schema-projectbody"></a>

### `ProjectBody`

What to change of a note that is a project. A field left out stays as it is; `null` takes its line out. At least one is sent.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The note's name. |
| `status` | `"active"` or `"paused"` or `"done"`, or `null` | no | The project's status; `null` makes the note no project. |
| `hue` | `"indigo"` or `"teal"` or `"coral"` or `"spruce"` or `"ochre"` or `"violet"` or `"magenta"` or `"moss"` or `"crimson"` or `"bronze"`, or `null` | no | Its colour, or `null` for none. |

<a id="schema-eventbody"></a>

### `EventBody`

When a note that is an event starts and ends. A field left out stays as it is; `null` takes its line out. A time with no offset is read in the vault's time zone.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The note's name. |
| `start` | string, or `null` | no | A date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, all day) or a time. |
| `end` | string, or `null` | no | In `start`'s form: a date for an all-day event, a time for a timed one. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `"claude"` or `"opencode"` or `"codex"` | yes | The harness that answers: the person's own Claude Code, OpenCode or Codex. |
| `model` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The model (`GET /__board/chat/models`). |
| `effort` | string | no | How hard it thinks; left out, the model's own. |
| `title` | string | no | Its title; left out, its first message. |

<a id="schema-chat"></a>

### `Chat`

A chat's `chat.json`, as this server answers it: each `grant:<vault>` key is a grant given here (`null` taken back).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | `1` | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `created` | string | yes |  |
| `home` | string | yes | The vault the chat lives in. |
| `provider` | `"claude"` or `"opencode"` or `"codex"` | yes |  |
| `model` | string | yes |  |
| `effort` | string | no |  |

<a id="schema-turn"></a>

### `Turn`

One message and what answered it: its steps, the blocks it changed things in, its status.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | `1` | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `chat` | string | yes |  |
| `text` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-renamechatbody"></a>

### `RenameChatBody`

A chat's new title.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The chat's id. |
| `title` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The title. |

<a id="schema-chatidbody"></a>

### `ChatIdBody`

A chat, by its id.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The chat's id. |

<a id="schema-turnbody"></a>

### `TurnBody`

A message to a chat; the answer streams on `/__board/chat/events`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The chat's id. |
| `text` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | What the person said. |
| `provider` | `"claude"` or `"opencode"` or `"codex"` | no | Another harness for this turn and the next; left out, the chat's. |
| `model` | string | no | Another model; left out, the chat's. |
| `effort` | string, or `null` | no | Another effort; `null` for the model's own; left out, the chat's. |
| `subject` | { name, kind }, or `null` | no | The document the chat works on: left out keeps the chat's, `null` drops it. |
| `mentions` | list of { name, kind }, at most 20 | no | Documents the message names with `@`, at most 20. |
| `mentions[].name` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes |  |
| `mentions[].kind` | `"board"` or `"note"` or `"quiz"` or `"table"` or `"file"` | yes |  |

<a id="schema-approvebody"></a>

### `ApproveBody`

The person's answer to a step waiting for approval.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `yes` | boolean | yes | Whether the step may go ahead. |
| `id` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The chat's id. |
| `step` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The step's id. |

<a id="schema-grantbody"></a>

### `GrantBody`

Give a chat another vault to read or change, or take it back.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"ask"` or `"edit"`, or `null` | no | `ask` (read it) or `edit` (change it too); `null` takes the grant back. Left out, `ask`. |
| `on` | boolean | no | `false` takes the grant back, as `mode: null` does. |
| `id` | string | yes | The chat's id. |
| `vault` | string | yes | The vault to grant. |

<a id="schema-undobody"></a>

### `UndoBody`

One block of a turn, whose changes to undo or redo.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The chat's id. |
| `turn` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The turn's id. |
| `block` | string, 1 to any number of characters | yes | The block's id. |

### `BlockBody`

A block to start in the running turn.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | What the block does, as the person reads it. |

<a id="schema-accessbody"></a>

### `AccessBody`

A chat asking the person for another vault.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `why` | string | no | Why, as the person reads it. |
| `mode` | `"ask"` or `"edit"` | no | What it asks for; left out, `ask`. |

<a id="schema-syncstatus"></a>

### `SyncStatus`

The current vault's link to a sync server.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vault` | string | yes |  |
| `linked` | boolean | yes |  |
| `state` | `"idle"` or `"syncing"` or `"offline"` or `"paused"` or `"error"` or `"unlinked"` | yes |  |
| `reason` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `server` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `remote` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `device` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `pending` | integer | yes |  |
| `conflicts` | list of string | yes |  |
| `last` | string, or `null` | yes |  |

<a id="schema-pairbody"></a>

### `PairBody`

A sync server's address and the one-time code its admin made, and what to call this device there.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server` | string | yes | The server's address: `https://`, or `http://` on this machine. |
| `code` | string | yes | The one-time code. |
| `device` | string | no | This device's name there; left out, the machine's host name. |

<a id="schema-linkbody"></a>

### `LinkBody`

How to link the vault: `upload` it as a new remote under a passphrase, `download` a remote into an empty vault, or `merge` the two by path.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"upload"` or `"download"` or `"merge"` | yes | Which. |
| `passphrase` | string | no | `upload`: at least eight characters. `download` and `merge`: the remote's, or `recovery`. |
| `recovery` | string | no | `download` and `merge`: the recovery code `upload` answered once. |
| `remote` | string | no | `download` and `merge`: the remote vault's id (`GET /api/sync/remotes`). |

### `SyncDevices`

The paired account's devices, this one marked `me`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devices` | list of { id, name, platform, created, seen, revoked, me } | yes |  |
| `devices[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `devices[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `devices[].platform` | string | yes |  |
| `devices[].created` | string | yes |  |
| `devices[].seen` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `devices[].revoked` | string, or `null` | yes |  |
| `devices[].me` | boolean | yes |  |

|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|

| `destination` | string, or `null` | yes |  |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

<a id="schema-feedbackbody"></a>

### `FeedbackBody`

A bug or an idea, with the documents and files the person chose to send with it. `boards` and `notes` are names in the vault, sent whole under their own name.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `"bug"` or `"idea"` | yes | Which. |
| `text` | string | yes | What happened, or what you would like. |
| `boards` | list of string, 1 to any number of characters, or `null` | no | Boards to send, by name. |
| `notes` | list of string, 1 to any number of characters, or `null` | no | Notes to send, by name. |
| `files` | list of { name, type, data }, or `null` | no | Files to send: `data` is the bytes as base64, or a `data:` URL. |

## Tokens

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | apiKey  | This launch's token: what `anydag serve` prints, kept in the app's home as `server.json` while it runs. |
| `cookie` | apiKey  | The token as a browser holds it: set by `/s/<secret>/?token=…`, sent only under that path. |
